title: Xironite
description: Many of our updates, features, and improvements are shaped directly by what you suggest, because we’re building this server with the community, not just for it. Our goal is to create survival-style servers for players who truly enjoy the classic survival!
body:
## 🌍 Xironite MC

Xironite is a community Minecraft server focused on **Survival** and **Towny** gameplay.  
Build your own town, claim land, grow with friends, and create your own community.

Trade with other players through a **player-driven economy**, explore the world, gather resources, and expand your town. Form alliances with other towns or compete for land and influence.

The server focuses on a **balanced survival experience**, active players, and a friendly community where both builders and grinders can enjoy the game.

Start small, grow your town, and leave your mark on the world.
